A [[town]] is a non-[[instance]]d location on the [[World Map]], as opposed to [[explorable area]]s. It is similar to an [[outpost]], but larger both in terms of size and [[NPC]] population, usually with all [[NPC service]]s present.

[[Region]]s have at most a single town, with a few regions (such as the [[Ring of Fire Islands]]) having none at all.

Towns are also sometimes referred to as cities, and also as a general term used to encompass outposts and mission outposts.

*You enter and exit a town by passing through a [[portal]]. 
*Towns can be selected for [[Map-Travel]].
*A maximum of 20 [[miniature]]s can be in use by players at any one time.
*A [[character]] is displayed as empty handed when in town regardless of what [[weapon]] or [[focus item]]/[[shield]] is equipped.
*[[Death Penalty]], [[Morale Boost]], and [[Blessing]]s are lost when entering a town. 
*A town can hold a maximum of 100 characters. If full, additional characters are placed in a new [[district]].
*The towns in [[The Jade Sea]] and [[Echovald Forest]] can be [[Alliance#Controlled outposts and towns|controlled by player alliances]], which provides some special benefits to the owner guilds.
